name: Basel grid
lineage: Swiss International Style, Basel and Zurich schools, 1950s-70s
spark: The grid is not scaffolding you hide; it is the design, and one red mark does all the emotional work.
system: Palette/material: white surface with the column grid exposed as hairlines; ink near-black; exactly one signal red per viewport
Type/composition: one neo-grotesque family at two weights; flush-left rag-right; size jumps of 3x, never 1.2x
Topology/navigation: content locks to twelve columns with asymmetric spans; nav is a single ruled line of text links
Controls/state: buttons are ruled boxes that invert to ink on press; active state is the red mark migrating
Responsive/motion: columns collapse by halving; motion is none or a single hard-cut reveal
webLeverage: CSS subgrid keeps nested content on the exposed master grid

name: Bauhaus catalog
lineage: Bauhaus Dessau exhibition catalogs and prospectuses, 1920s
spark: A page that believes geometry is moral: circle, triangle, bar, and a diagonal that earns its angle.
system: Palette/material: warm off-white with primary red, blue, yellow as flat geometry, never as tints
Type/composition: geometric sans, heavy lowercase; rotated type only along a load-bearing diagonal
Topology/navigation: sections keyed by a numbered geometric marker; nav is a horizontal band of numbers
Controls/state: hover fills the shape behind the label; pressed swaps figure and ground
Responsive/motion: the diagonal flattens to horizontal bands on small screens; one rotation animates once
webLeverage: CSS transform with transform-origin makes the rotated headline settle once on load

name: Constructivist poster
lineage: Rodchenko and El Lissitzky poster work, 1920s
spark: Red wedge, black bar, a shouted word set on the diagonal: the page as agitation.
system: Palette/material: bone paper, red and black only; no third colour exists
Type/composition: condensed caps stacked and angled; scale contrast does the shouting
Topology/navigation: hard wedges and photomontage crops direct the eye along one vector per viewport
Controls/state: controls are black bars; hover drives the red wedge through them
Responsive/motion: angles reduce to stacked bars on mobile; one wedge translates in, once
webLeverage: clip-path polygons build the wedges and crops without images

name: Deco travel poster
lineage: Art Deco railway and ocean-liner posters, 1920s-30s
spark: Dusk laid down in flat bands behind one monumental object that owns the page.
system: Palette/material: gradient dusk rendered as four flat stepped bands, never a smooth mesh; deep navy ground at the base
Type/composition: tall geometric display caps, tight tracking; a small ruled caption footer
Topology/navigation: one monumental subject per section, small text yields to it; nav is a slim top rule
Controls/state: buttons are lozenges with a metallic-adjacent border; hover deepens the band behind them
Responsive/motion: bands stay full-bleed at every width; parallax banned, one slow band-light shift allowed
webLeverage: repeating-linear-gradient with hard colour stops builds the stepped dusk in one declaration

name: NASA standards
lineage: NASA Graphics Standards Manual, Danne and Blackburn, 1975
spark: A specification page so confident it numbers its own figures.
system: Palette/material: cool white; one federal red accent; grey only as hairline rules
Type/composition: wide grotesque caps for headings, generous tracking; body flush-left under ruled captions
Topology/navigation: numbered figures (fig 4.1) anchor every section; nav is a numeric index
Controls/state: controls carry spec numbers; active state is the red rule thickening under the number
Responsive/motion: figures reflow but keep their numbers; motion limited to a measured underline draw
webLeverage: CSS counters auto-number figures and sections so the numbering never drifts

name: Penguin grid
lineage: Penguin paperback covers, Tschichold and Marber grid, 1947-62
spark: Three fixed bands, colour codes the category, and the band line never moves an inch.
system: Palette/material: one saturated category colour filling the top band; cream centre band; the colour returns at the base
Type/composition: serif title case in the cream band; publisher-mark discipline, nothing decorative
Topology/navigation: every section is the same band structure at a fixed ratio; colour changes, structure never does
Controls/state: controls live in the colour band and reverse out of it; hover swaps band and text colours
Responsive/motion: the ratio holds at every width; the only motion is a band colour cross-fade between sections
webLeverage: CSS custom properties swap the category colour per section while the band geometry stays fixed

name: Riso zine
lineage: Risograph small-press printing, 1980s to now
spark: Two soy inks slightly out of register, and the mistake is the signature.
system: Palette/material: uncoated stock tinted pink or blue; two spot inks that overprint to a third colour
Type/composition: chunky bold sans, hand-lettered moments allowed; halftone dots stand in for photography
Topology/navigation: stapled-spread logic, sections as loose pages; nav hand-drawn as a contents scrawl
Controls/state: buttons are ink blocks with visible misregistration; press shifts the second ink 2px
Responsive/motion: misregistration settles once on load (under 400ms) and never loops
webLeverage: mix-blend-mode multiply makes the two inks genuinely overprint

name: Whole Earth spread
lineage: Whole Earth Catalog, 1968-74
spark: Dense, ink-heavy conviction: every item reviewed, priced, and argued for in six-point type.
system: Palette/material: newsprint cream, ink-dense; no accent colour, emphasis is weight
Type/composition: typewriter body under bold serif headers; captions run right up against images
Topology/navigation: multi-column item entries with inline prices; an index does the navigating
Controls/state: links underlined in ink; visited state is a hand-drawn check in the margin
Responsive/motion: columns drop one at a time; no motion, the density is the energy
webLeverage: CSS multi-column layout with column-rule gives real newsprint flow

name: Isotype board
lineage: Otto Neurath's Isotype pictogram system, 1920s-40s
spark: Quantity is repetition, never scaling: fifty units is fifty marks, and you can count them.
system: Palette/material: flat white; black; one signal red reserved for the exception in the data
Type/composition: humanist sans captions beneath pictogram rows; a unit legend at the foot
Topology/navigation: every claim becomes a pictogram row; sections are chart plates with numbered titles
Controls/state: hovering a row highlights its unit count; the red unit is the interactive one
Responsive/motion: rows wrap, units never shrink; units populate left to right, once
webLeverage: inline SVG symbols with use elements repeat the unit pictogram at zero cost

name: Specimen broadsheet
lineage: Type-foundry specimen sheets, 19th century
spark: The typeface is the product, shown at every size it owns, waterfall after waterfall.
system: Palette/material: cream broadsheet, ink only; a foundry footer in tiny caps
Type/composition: one family at every size as content; waterfall settings, no placeholder text
Topology/navigation: sized specimens are the sections; a ruled index of point sizes navigates
Controls/state: hover sets the specimen line in the accent weight; controls are ruled boxes
Responsive/motion: the waterfall re-breaks by width; one variable-font weight settle on load
webLeverage: variable font axes animated once with font-variation-settings make the waterfall breathe

name: Letterpress playbill
lineage: Broadside ballads and theatre playbills, 18th-19th century
spark: A different wood type on every line, all centered, and the bill still reads top to bottom like thunder.
system: Palette/material: cream rag paper, black ink, one spot red for the star act
Type/composition: stacked centered lines, a different display face per line; rule dividers between acts
Topology/navigation: strict top-to-bottom bill hierarchy; nav is the bill's own running order
Controls/state: controls are ruled bill lines; hover sets the line in spot red
Responsive/motion: the stack narrows, never reflows sideways; no motion beyond an ink-in on load
webLeverage: text-wrap balance keeps every centered wood-type line breaking evenly

name: Matchbox label
lineage: Japanese matchbox labels, Meiji through Showa eras
spark: One animal in a cartouche is the entire brand, and the border does the rest.
system: Palette/material: kraft ground; two flat inks; the illustration is the only image on the page
Type/composition: hand-drawn logotype in a cartouche; supporting text tiny and outward-facing like an edge label
Topology/navigation: every section framed by a printed border; the mark recurs small as a wayfinder
Controls/state: buttons are bordered chips; hover thickens the border, press fills the cartouche
Responsive/motion: the border scales with the container; motion is a single stamp-down of the mark
webLeverage: border-image turns one SVG frame into every container's printed border

name: Pharma sachet
lineage: Geigy pharmaceutical packaging and literature, 1950s-60s
spark: Clinical calm with one enormous abstract shape carrying all the feeling the copy refuses to.
system: Palette/material: clinical white; one large flat geometric figure in a single saturated colour
Type/composition: akzidenz-class grotesque, lowercase; dosage-table clarity in the data
Topology/navigation: each section pairs a cool table with one warm abstract figure; nav is a thin rule of lowercase links
Controls/state: controls are precise 1px-bordered fields; focus is the figure's colour, nothing else is
Responsive/motion: the figure crops before it shrinks; it drifts a few pixels over 20s, imperceptibly
webLeverage: SVG shapes with CSS offset-path give the abstract figure its slow drift

name: Seed packet
lineage: American seed-packet lithography, 1900s-40s
spark: The tomato on the front is redder than any tomato has ever been, and the planting table on the back is dead honest.
system: Palette/material: cream stock; one saturated produce illustration; a banner ribbon in a second colour
Type/composition: ornamented display caps in the banner; the back-of-pack table set plain and tabular
Topology/navigation: front-of-pack hierarchy (variety, vignette, promise) then the honest table; sections alternate front and back
Controls/state: the CTA is the banner ribbon; hover ripples the ribbon ends 2px
Responsive/motion: illustration stays dominant at all widths; one bloom-in on load, then still
webLeverage: SVG filters posterize the illustration into genuine lithograph flats

name: Teletext page
lineage: Ceefax and Minitel broadcast text services, 1970s-80s
spark: Page 302 of a broadcast that never stops: block mosaics, double-height caps, colours with no opinions about taste.
system: Palette/material: true black ground; saturated RGB block colours straight from the palette register
Type/composition: double-height bitmap caps for headers; body in the same monospace grid
Topology/navigation: three-digit page numbers are the nav; a header row carries page and time
Controls/state: selection is a colour-block cursor; links are coloured index rows
Responsive/motion: the character grid scales as a unit; one row-by-row paint-in on load, top to bottom
webLeverage: ch units and a monospace grid keep every block mosaic cell true to the character cell

name: Transit wayfinding
lineage: Vignelli subway diagram and Calvert-Kinneir motorway signage, 1960s-70s
spark: A sign system that gets you off at the right exit without you noticing you read it.
system: Palette/material: high-contrast panel colours (one per line of business) with white reversal; dark charcoal ground
Type/composition: one transport grotesque, mixed case, huge x-height; arrows are typography
Topology/navigation: destination hierarchy (line, station, exit); coloured discs badge the categories
Controls/state: controls are sign panels; active is the white bar under the destination
Responsive/motion: panels stack like stacked signs; motion is a panel slide with a hard stop
webLeverage: scroll-driven animations pin the line diagram while stations tick past

name: Racing livery
lineage: Motorsport liveries and roundel number plates, 1960s-70s
spark: One team colour against white, a giant number in a roundel, and sponsor patches held in strict formation.
system: Palette/material: one saturated team colour blocked hard against white; matte black for numerals
Type/composition: huge condensed numerals, no italics; small sponsor-grid text disciplined to one zone
Topology/navigation: sections read as body panels, colour breaks at panel lines; nav is the number roundel row
Controls/state: the roundel is the button; hover rotates the number plate a degree, press stamps it flat
Responsive/motion: panel lines re-break at width changes; one chequered wipe on section change
webLeverage: CSS clip-path panel lines let the team colour break exactly where the bodywork would

name: Bus blind
lineage: London bus destination blinds and roller signs
spark: White and yellow letterforms on black, sized like they have somewhere to be.
system: Palette/material: black ground; letterforms in white and one yellow only
Type/composition: one grotesque in capitals at extreme size; via-points in a smaller line beneath
Topology/navigation: destination stacking is the page structure; each section is a blind frame
Controls/state: controls are blind windows; changing state rolls the text vertically like the blind
Responsive/motion: type scales to fill the frame edge to edge; the roll is the one motion, stepped not smooth
webLeverage: steps() easing on translateY makes the destination roll land like a real blind

name: Blue Note sleeve
lineage: Reid Miles cover design for Blue Note Records, 1955-67
spark: A duotone musician mid-phrase, type slicing across the photograph like a horn line.
system: Palette/material: one-colour duotone photography over deep ink ground; a second flat colour for type blocks only
Type/composition: tight grotesque set in bars and angles that cut across the image; lowercase confidence
Topology/navigation: every section is a sleeve: image field plus one typographic intervention; track-list rows navigate
Controls/state: controls are type bars; hover shifts the duotone hue, press knocks the bar out of the photo
Responsive/motion: the crop tightens before the type shrinks; one slow duotone shift per viewport
webLeverage: CSS filter plus mix-blend-mode builds real duotones from ordinary photographs

name: Bass title card
lineage: Saul Bass film title sequences and posters, 1950s-60s
spark: A torn paper shape on a flat colour field tells you the whole story before a word lands.
system: Palette/material: one saturated field colour per act; torn black silhouette shapes; white text only
Type/composition: irregular hand-cut display letters or a plain grotesque, nothing between; asymmetric placement
Topology/navigation: sections are acts, each a new field colour and one shape; the cast list is the footer
Controls/state: controls are cut-out shapes; hover jitters the tear 1px, press inverts shape and field
Responsive/motion: shapes rescale as silhouettes; one shape assembles from two pieces per section, once
webLeverage: SVG clip-path with jagged polygon points gives genuine torn edges at any scale

name: Atelier populaire broadside
lineage: Silkscreened posters of the Paris ateliers, May 1968
spark: One colour, pulled through a screen in a hurry, saying exactly one thing.
system: Palette/material: kraft or raw white; a single flat ink (red or black); screen texture where the ink thins
Type/composition: hand-cut caps drawn fast, slightly irregular; the slogan is the layout
Topology/navigation: one message per section, full width; nav is a strip of small stencilled words
Controls/state: buttons are stencil cuts; press pulls a second pass of ink (darker, slightly offset)
Responsive/motion: the slogan wraps by hand-set breakpoints; no motion, urgency is static
webLeverage: an SVG feTurbulence filter thins the ink exactly where a squeegee would starve it

name: Ordnance quadrangle
lineage: USGS and Ordnance Survey topographic sheets, 20th century
spark: A landscape flattened to hairline contours, and the margins full of quiet institutional truth.
system: Palette/material: paper white with hairline contour density in brown; water in one blue; a marginalia frame
Type/composition: small caps for place names, italic reserved for water alone; datum notes in tiny sans
Topology/navigation: the sheet grid with edge coordinates is the layout; sections are named quadrangles
Controls/state: hover raises a contour line's weight; selected areas get the survey's red grid tick
Responsive/motion: the frame margins hold at every width; contours draw in once, slowly, on first view
webLeverage: SVG stroke-dashoffset animates the contour draw without a single image asset

name: Stamp sheet
lineage: Engraved postage sheets and philatelic presentation packs
spark: Forty identical engravings separated by perforations, and every one of them is treasury-grade.
system: Palette/material: pale gum-paper ground; each stamp a one-colour engraving; selvedge margins carry plate numbers
Type/composition: engraved-style serif for denominations; tiny caps for country and series
Topology/navigation: content cells are stamps in a perforated sheet grid; the selvedge is the nav rail
Controls/state: hover lifts a stamp with a soft paper shadow; selection tears it along the perforation
Responsive/motion: the sheet re-grids without breaking perforation rhythm; one lift-and-settle per interaction
webLeverage: a repeating radial-gradient mask cuts true perforated edges on every cell

name: Banknote engraving
lineage: Intaglio currency engraving and guilloche security lathework
spark: A page that spends its whole budget proving it cannot be forged.
system: Palette/material: pale money-green or ochre ground woven with fine guilloche linework; one seal in a second ink
Type/composition: engraved serif numerals at denomination scale; microtext rules that read up close
Topology/navigation: sections framed like note faces with corner denominations; the seal badges the key claim
Controls/state: controls are engraved plaques; hover raises the lattice contrast, press embosses
Responsive/motion: guilloche density thins at small sizes instead of shrinking; a 30s lattice shimmer, barely there
webLeverage: layered repeating-conic-gradients generate live guilloche lattices with no artwork

name: Concrete poem
lineage: Concrete poetry movement, Gomringer and the Noigandres group, 1950s-60s
spark: The words are arranged as the thing they describe, and that arrangement is the whole design.
system: Palette/material: bare page, ink only; whitespace is the material being sculpted
Type/composition: one sans, one size; placement carries all meaning, no bold, no colour
Topology/navigation: each section is one poem-shaped arrangement; nav is a single line of words
Controls/state: interactive words are the ones out of place; hover moves a word into its meaning
Responsive/motion: arrangements recompose per breakpoint by design, not reflow; one word settles per section
webLeverage: CSS grid template areas hold each hand-placed word exactly where the poem needs it

name: Airline timetable
lineage: Mid-century airline timetables and route maps, 1950s-60s
spark: The schedule table is the layout, and the route arcs are the only decoration allowed aboard.
system: Palette/material: white with one airline livery colour; buff for the cover panels
Type/composition: tabular figures everywhere; tiny caps for city codes; flight numbers as anchors
Topology/navigation: content is departures rows (time, code, destination, note); tabs like ticket stock navigate
Controls/state: a row highlights in livery colour on hover; selected flights get the margin arrow
Responsive/motion: columns shed politely (note first, code last); rows tick in once like a posted schedule
webLeverage: font-variant-numeric tabular-nums locks every column of times into alignment

name: Card catalog
lineage: Library card catalogs and drawer indexes
spark: Every fact on its own manila card, typed, stamped, and filed where fingers can walk to it.
system: Palette/material: manila and buff cards on a dark oak drawer ground; rubber-stamp red for status
Type/composition: typewriter mono with underline emphasis; call numbers top-left, always
Topology/navigation: drawer-and-card structure; tabbed dividers are the nav; one card raised per view
Controls/state: hover slides a card up 8px from the drawer; selection stamps it in red
Responsive/motion: drawers become a single column of tabs; the card slide is the only motion
webLeverage: CSS scroll-snap makes the drawer riffle card by card under the thumb

name: Double-entry ledger
lineage: Bookkeeping ledgers and banker's stationery, 19th-20th century
spark: Pale green ruled paper where every claim has to balance against another, in ink, by hand.
system: Palette/material: pale green or buff ruled stock; iron-ink near-black; red reserved for deficit alone
Type/composition: copperplate-adjacent headers over mono figures; double rule closes every total
Topology/navigation: debit and credit columns structure every section; the running balance is the thread
Controls/state: rows confirm with a posted tick; unbalanced states show red in the difference column only
Responsive/motion: columns fold to stacked entries that keep their rule lines; a total counts up once and closes
webLeverage: background-image linear-gradient rulings keep the ledger lines pixel-true at any size

name: Line-printer output
lineage: Punched-card decks and tractor-feed line-printer reports, 1960s-70s
spark: Greenbar stripes, uppercase mono, a job number in the header: the machine's own handwriting.
system: Palette/material: greenbar striped paper (alternating pale bands); ink near-black; no accent, emphasis is overstrike
Type/composition: uppercase mono only; fixed-width report blocks; page headers carry job and date
Topology/navigation: content arrives as numbered report sections; the sprocket margin is the scroll rail
Controls/state: selection is an overstruck line; errors print as a flagged exception row, never a red banner
Responsive/motion: the character grid rewraps at column counts, not pixels; output prints in line by line, once
webLeverage: a steps() typing animation prints the report a full line at a time, never a character

name: Blueprint
lineage: Cyanotype architectural and engineering blueprints
spark: Prussian blue all the way down, white lines doing all the talking, a revision table that never lies.
system: Palette/material: deep prussian-blue ground; pure white linework; one process-yellow highlight for the current revision
Type/composition: stencil-adjacent caps in the title block; dimension chains in small mono
Topology/navigation: orthographic views structure sections; the title block anchors every page corner
Controls/state: hover thickens a dimension chain; approved states get the checker's initials
Responsive/motion: drawings crop by viewport like a print table; white lines draw in once on first view
webLeverage: SVG stroke-dashoffset draws the plan's white lines the way a pen plotter would

name: Nautical chart
lineage: Admiralty nautical charts, 19th-20th century
spark: Depth soundings scattered like seed, land in buff, and a compass rose that has earned its ornament.
system: Palette/material: pale sea-tint ground with buff landmasses; magenta reserved for lights and warnings
Type/composition: italic hydrographic labels for water, upright caps for coast; soundings as scattered small numerals
Topology/navigation: the chart frame with edge scales is the layout; hazards badge in magenta
Controls/state: plotted courses are the selected state; hover shows a bearing line from the rose
Responsive/motion: the frame holds, the chart pans; one course line draws in per section
webLeverage: SVG textPath curves the coastal labels along the actual coastline

name: Observatory logbook
lineage: Scientific expedition and observatory logbooks
spark: Dated entries in iron-gall ink with the sketch pasted in and the coordinates in the margin.
system: Palette/material: ivory ruled pages; iron-gall near-black that browns at the edges; one wax-red seal colour
Type/composition: serif entries with upright figures for data; marginal coordinates in small caps
Topology/navigation: strictly chronological entries; the margin rail of dates is the nav
Controls/state: today's entry is the open page; hover tilts a pasted sketch 1 degree
Responsive/motion: margins collapse into inline date stamps; a new entry blots in once
webLeverage: CSS position sticky keeps the date rail fixed while entries scroll like turned pages

name: Herbarium sheet
lineage: Botanical herbarium specimen sheets
spark: One pressed specimen centered, and a hundred years of annotation slips accumulating around it.
system: Palette/material: aged white sheet; specimen greens gone khaki; accession-stamp violet as the accent
Type/composition: typed determinavit labels bottom-right; latin binomials in italic, collectors in caps
Topology/navigation: one specimen per section, annotations orbit it; the accession number indexes everything
Controls/state: hover lifts an annotation slip; verified state adds the determiner's stamp
Responsive/motion: slips reflow around the specimen, never over it; one slip settles per section
webLeverage: CSS shape-outside lets the annotation text wrap the specimen's actual silhouette

name: Vitrine label
lineage: Museum object labels and vitrine cards
spark: Object number, title, medium, provenance: four quiet lines doing justice to the thing above them.
system: Palette/material: gallery white; ink only; the objects carry all colour
Type/composition: one quiet serif at two sizes with generous leading; the number line in small caps
Topology/navigation: object-and-label pairs structure the page; a numbered checklist navigates
Controls/state: hover raises the label's rule; selection adds the loan-collection dot
Responsive/motion: labels stay under their objects at every width; no motion, gallery stillness
webLeverage: CSS grid with subgrid keeps every label's four lines aligned across the gallery row

name: Rams instruction card
lineage: Braun product literature under Dieter Rams, 1960s-70s
spark: Pale grey calm where colour appears only on the control being explained.
system: Palette/material: pale warm grey; ink dark grey; one signal colour appearing only on the referenced control
Type/composition: small akzidenz-style labels, numbered; generous silence between figures
Topology/navigation: exploded views with index lines structure sections; numbers cross-reference text to diagram
Controls/state: hovering text lights its control in the diagram and vice versa; nothing else reacts
Responsive/motion: diagrams stack above their text; index lines redraw once per layout
webLeverage: CSS :has() lets the diagram highlight when its matching text row is hovered, no script

name: Recipe card
lineage: Mid-century boxed recipe cards
spark: Ingredients on the left rail, method numbered on the right, a gingham band saying someone cooks here.
system: Palette/material: cream card; one gingham or solid tint band; a category tab colour
Type/composition: friendly serif title, typewriter body; quantities in tabular figures
Topology/navigation: ingredients rail left, numbered method right; index tabs navigate categories
Controls/state: steps check off with a pencil tick; the active step's number fills the tab colour
Responsive/motion: the rail drops above the method on small cards; one card-flip per section change
webLeverage: CSS counters number the method steps so inserted steps renumber themselves

name: Classifieds page
lineage: Phone-book yellow pages and newspaper classifieds
spark: Six-point type, column rules, and a bold header shouting PIANO, MUST SELL.
system: Palette/material: yellow or newsprint ground, ink-dense; one red stamp for featured entries
Type/composition: bold condensed headers over tiny body; ad boxes of mixed sizes earn their borders
Topology/navigation: alphabetical tabs and column rules; the boxed ads are the featured tier
Controls/state: hover raises an ad box's border weight; placed state adds the red PAID stamp
Responsive/motion: columns drop but the rules stay; no motion, the density hums by itself
webLeverage: CSS columns with column-rule reflow the classifieds while keeping the printed rules

name: Matchbook
lineage: American matchbook covers, 1930s-60s
spark: Front hook, spine message, back offer: a complete pitch on two square inches.
system: Palette/material: one saturated ground colour; foil-adjacent gold accents; the striker strip as a texture band
Type/composition: script wordmark over a condensed caps address line; tiny type that stays proud
Topology/navigation: tiny-canvas discipline per section (hook, spine, offer); sections snap like a flipped book
Controls/state: the CTA is the striker strip; press strikes it with a brief spark of the accent
Responsive/motion: the canvas stays small and centered by choice; one flip between faces
webLeverage: CSS 3D transform flips the matchbook face to back on interaction

name: Mixing desk
lineage: Inline recording consoles, SSL and Neve channel strips, 1970s-80s
spark: Ninety-six faders in ranks, and the one that matters is under your hand.
system: Palette/material: charcoal panel ground; per-function knob colours (red record, green bus, white trim); brushed metal rails
Type/composition: tiny engraved caps labels under every control; channel numbers in a larger mono
Topology/navigation: vertical channel strips structure content; the master section anchors the page foot
Controls/state: faders and knobs are the controls; state reads as physical position plus one LED dot
Responsive/motion: strips shed to a bussed summary on small screens; meters move, nothing else does
webLeverage: input type=range restyled with accent-color and a custom track becomes a true fader bank

name: Modular patchbay
lineage: Moog and Serge modular synthesizer panels, 1960s-70s
spark: A wall of jacks and one patch cable that explains everything by where it goes.
system: Palette/material: matte black or brushed aluminium panels; cable colours as the only saturation; silk-screened white legends
Type/composition: small caps silk-screen labels; module names in a wider tracked grotesque
Topology/navigation: modules are the sections; drawn patch cables literally connect related content
Controls/state: jacks are link points; a patched connection is the selected state, cable and all
Responsive/motion: modules re-rack vertically; cables re-drape with a settle, motion ends there
webLeverage: SVG cubic bezier paths drape the patch cables with believable slack

name: Split-flap board
lineage: Solari di Udine departure boards, 1956 onward
spark: The clatter of forty flaps landing on the word you were waiting for.
system: Palette/material: near-black board; off-white flap characters; one amber row for delays and exceptions
Type/composition: one condensed gothic per flap cell, uppercase; the split line across every character
Topology/navigation: ranked rows (time, code, destination, remark) are the content; the header row is fixed
Controls/state: updates flip through intermediate characters; the amber row is the alert state
Responsive/motion: columns shed right to left; the flap animation is the single signature motion
webLeverage: CSS 3D rotateX at the character midline reproduces the physical flap fall

name: Oscilloscope
lineage: Tektronix cathode-ray oscilloscopes, 1950s-70s
spark: A single green trace on a graticule, telling the truth at the speed of light.
system: Palette/material: deep green-black screen with an etched graticule; phosphor green trace; bone control panel around it
Type/composition: engraved caps on the panel; measurements in mono; the trace is the display type
Topology/navigation: one screen per section with its control cluster; V/div and T/div framing as section metadata
Controls/state: rotary knobs and toggle states; the trace responds live to the section's data
Responsive/motion: the screen stays 4:3 and centered; only the trace moves, everything else is bolted down
webLeverage: an inline SVG polyline driven by requestAnimationFrame draws a live phosphor trace

name: Flight-deck placard
lineage: Transport-aircraft cockpit placards and annunciator panels
